title: Tasks/Calendars keywords, categories, replyTo, defaultAlerts container shapes differ
description: Sibling divergence left out of JMAP-skk9.7 (which aligned only the complex RFC 8984 sub-object fields). calendars-types CalendarEvent.keywords/categories/reply_to are Option<serde_json::Value> (event.rs:192,196,270) while tasks-types Task uses Option<BTreeMap<String,bool>> / Option<BTreeMap<String,String>> (task.rs:372,376,423). Calendar.default_alerts_with_time/without_time key on String (calendar.rs:151,155) while TaskList keys on Id (task_list.rs:180,185). These are flat String[Boolean]/String[String] maps, not large extensible objects, so AGENTS.md sloppy-Value does not obviously apply; pick one shape before 0.4 (likely: calendars adopts the typed maps) or record as deliberate. Unifying later is a semver break.
close_reason: Batch 20 (run wf_770a5fbb-59c): implemented, adversarially verified, full CI green at 8484b9c3
